description: This file contains unit tests for data input/output functions related to CSV parsing, serialization, and reading list export in a library management frontend application. It mocks external services and APIs to test functions like stringifyCSV, parseFile, validateRows, and exportReadingListCSV.

methods.name: fakeFile(name, content)

methods.name: test
